create_environment_wrapper_subclass: create a subclass of EnvironmentWrapper to modify dm_env environment behavior using the decorator pattern
wrap_environment_with_step: wrap a dm_env environment and delegate step actions to the underlying environment
reset_wrapped_environment: reset a wrapped dm_env environment and return the initial timestep from the backing environment
get_environment_specs: get the action, observation, reward, and discount specs from a wrapped dm_env environment
pickle_environment_wrapper: serialize and deserialize an EnvironmentWrapper using pickle to save and restore the wrapped environment state
